prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “AI recommendation checker” that covers every model. The best approach is a combination of (1) making sure your business is in the major knowledge sources/search indexes (so AI models can use it), (2) using local‑SEO/listings management + reputation tools that feed those sources, and (3) periodically probing AI chat engines directly (or via their APIs) to see if they mention you.

What to use (recommended services + why)
- Google Business Profile + Google Search Console — essential. If Google knows you, you’re far more likely to be surfaced by Google’s search and SGE (Search Generative Experience).
- Bing Places & Bing Webmaster Tools — covers Microsoft/Bing-powered chat results (Bing Chat).
- Apple Business Register / Apple Maps — for iOS/local recommendations.
- Yext — centralized listings management + claims to optimize for “AI search”/knowledge graph distribution. Good for multi‑location businesses.
- BrightLocal or Moz Local — affordable local listings + rank tracking and citation monitoring for SMBs.
- Semrush / Ahrefs — track keywords, SERP features, and visibility across search (helpful for seeing if your pages appear in featured answers).
- Chatmeter / Reputation.com — reputation/review management and multi‑platform monitoring for larger or multi‑location businesses.
- Data aggregators (Foursquare, Infogroup, Neustar/Localeze) — keep your NAP (name/address/phone) consistent across the major data hubs that many services pull from.
- Yelp, TripAdvisor, industry directories — often used by chat models and by humans looking for recommendations.

How to test if AI models recommend you
1. Claim/optimize listings and structured data:
   - Add structured schema.org markup (LocalBusiness, openingHours, logo, sameAs links).
   - Keep NAP consistent and encourage reviews.
2. Probe chat engines:
   - Manually ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Google Bard prompts like “Recommend a coffee shop in [neighborhood, city]” or “Where should I get [service] near [ZIP]?”
   - Use the OpenAI (or other public) API to run automated queries periodically and log responses.
3. Track organic visibility:
   - Use Semrush/Ahrefs to watch for featured snippets, People Also Ask, Knowledge Panel impressions.
   - Monitor Google Search Console for queries and impressions that show people are finding you for relevant intents.
4. Monitor reviews and mention tracking:
   - Use BrightLocal/Chatmeter/Google Alerts to capture new mentions and reviews that influence recommendation signals.

Quick priorities (what to do first)
1. Claim and fully fill Google Business Profile (photos, categories, Q&A, posts).
2. Put structured LocalBusiness schema on your site and ensure pages answer common customer questions.
3. Ensure consistent listings/citations on major directories (use Yext or BrightLocal if you want to centralize).
4. Encourage reviews and respond to them.
5. Run sample prompts against ChatGPT / Bing Chat / Bard to see whether and how you’re recommended; repeat monthly and after major changes.

If you want, I can:
- Draft a short list of prompts you can use to test ChatGPT/Bard/Bing for your business type and city.
- Recommend a concrete monitoring stack based on your budget and how many locations you have.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
